errors.text: The hypothesis specifies room-temperature tensile testing, whereas the target result is based on room-temperature compression testing.

The claim that Laves-phase formation is driven by highly negative Cr-Ta mixing enthalpy is unsupported and does not accurately reconstruct the reported multicomponent Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) phase chemistry.
The cited evidence does not directly support the Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr-Cr alloy, its reticulated Laves phase, or the claimed mechanical improvements.
